kicker: HERO KAI × SAN JIE 17 GUARDIANS • ACT III: CITADEL SIEGE • ENGLISH WEBTOON v6.0
title: CHAPTER 11: THE HALL OF ECHOING MIRRORS
subtitle: Dark mirror ambushes, last-breath crystal cages, Mirror-Sage purification, Vex's betrayal trap & the 17-Guardian final stand!

balloons.text: HIGH ABOVE THE TWILIGHT CLOUDS, A RAINBOW BRIDGE LEADS TO THE LAST GUARDIAN SANCTUARY...
THERE IT IS! THE MIRROR SPIRE!
STAY CLOSE, SQUAD FOUR!
THOSE MIRRORS... THEY SHOW PEOPLE ALL ALONE...
MALCODE'S GLITCH FEEDS ON DOUBT. DON'T LET IT TRICK US.
LOOK OUT! THE GLASS IS SHATTERING!
THREE MIRROR PORTALS! HOLD YOUR GROUND!
EACH ARCHWAY IS PULLING US IN!
THE HALL SPLITS INTO THREE ILLUSION TRIALS TO TEST SQUAD FOUR'S COURAGE!
THE MIRRORS ARE SHIFTING — OUR SHADOWS ARE STEPPING OUT!!
THEY FEED ON OUR DOUBTS... STAY TOGETHER, SQUAD FOUR!!
DARK REFLECTIONS EMERGE FROM THE GLASS — TURNING THE HALL INTO A LABYRINTH!
KAI XIANG & OKX — CIPHER RUNE FILTER, ENGAGE!
THAT ARMOR IS JUST AN EMPTY MIRAGE!

code_tray.output: MIRAGE CLEARED! Shadow Knight shattered into harmless light!

balloons.text: BEHIND ME! MIMIK-SPARK, PRISM BARRIER!
YOU'VE GOT THIS, JING CHENG!
MY PRISM BARRIER SHATTERED!! OKX — MIMIK-SPARK — WATCH OUT!!
YOUR FRAGILE LOGIC CANNOT STOP THE MIRROR ABYSS!!
THE CORRUPTED MIRROR-WRAITH SMASHES THEIR DEFENSE — BLASTING BOTH PARTNERS BACK!
QIU RONG & MIKU — CHIME ARROW, CLEAR THE SHADOW!
SHI YE & CATICORN — RAINBOW YARN, UNRAVEL IT!
MIKU!! CATICORN!! THE CRYSTAL CAGES ARE DRAINING THEM!!
MY LOTUS SHIELD IS CRACKING!! HANG ON, SQUAD FOUR!!
TRAPPED IN DRAINING PRISMS, ONLY ONE LAST BREATH STANDS BETWEEN THEM AND DEFEAT...
WE REFUSE TO LOSE OUR PARTNERS!! HANDS TOGETHER — NOW!!
FOUR HEARTS — SHATTER THIS DARKNESS!!
THEIR JOINED PALMS IGNITE A BLINDING FOUR-COLOR RESONANCE — SHATTERING EVERY CAGE!
FOUR RELICS — ONE HEARTBEAT!
OUR VIRTUES ARE SYNCING TOGETHER!

lines: for guardian, pet in zip(squad4, pets):
code_tray.output: RESONANCE 100%! All 4 Squad-4 partners entering Evolution!

balloons.text: FLAME, VIOLET SPARK, EMERALD MOONLIGHT, AND RAINBOW STARLIGHT ENFOLD THE FOUR PARTNERS...
THEIR STAGE-TWO BONDS RISE IN A WHIRLWIND OF PURE GUARDIAN LIGHT!
GRAND EVOLUTION UNLEASHED!
OKX, MIMIK-SPARK, MIKU, AND STAR-YARN CATICORN ASCEND TO FULL POWER!
WHOA, OKX! YOUR CAPE IS AMAZING!
LOOK AT MIKU AND CATICORN — SO RADIANT!
FOURFOLD HARMONY BEAM — FIRE!!
NO!! MY MIRROR PHANTOM... DISINTEGRATING!!
AAAH!! THE DARK CRYSTALS... PEELING AWAY!!
THIS LIGHT... I REMEMBER THE MIRRORS OF TRUTH...
MALCODE'S BUG CHAINS SNAP — REVEALING AN ANCIENT CRYSTAL MIRROR-SAGE BENEATH!
BEFORE THE INVASION, THE MIRROR-SAGE GUARDED PYTHONIA'S SANCTUARY OF TRUTH.
UNTIL LORD MALCODE AMBUSHED THE HALL AND TWISTED TRUTH INTO LONELINESS!
THANK YOU, YOUNG HEROES! TAKE THIS TRUE MIRROR SHARD — IT SHOWS THE HEART!
WE'LL USE ITS LIGHT TO REACH VEX! THANK YOU, MIRROR-SAGE!
WITH THE PURIFIED MIRROR-SAGE'S BLESSING, ONLY ONE CONFRONTATION REMAINS...
STOP, VEX! YOU DON'T HAVE TO SERVE MALCODE!
YOU KNOW NOTHING, KAI! NOBODY LISTENED TO MY CODE!
CORRUPT OVERRIDE!!
DEF DEBUG!! WE'LL PATCH YOUR HEART, VEX!

code_tray.output: DEBUG COMPLETE! Malcode's visor override is cracking!

balloons.text: EMBER, GET BACK!! HIS GLITCH STORM IS OVERLOADING MY SHIELD!!
WHY WON'T YOU FIGHT BACK, KAI?! SHATTER ALREADY!!
VEX UNLEASHES EVERY CRYSTAL IN THE HALL — CRACKING KAI'S GOLDEN LOTUS TO ITS LIMIT!
STOP, VEX! WE'RE NOT YOUR ENEMIES — LOOK INTO THE TRUE MIRROR SHARD!
WHAT...?! THEY HAVE STAGE 3 POWER... YET THEY'RE LOWERING THEIR HANDS?!
MERCY CUTS DEEPER THAN ANY STRIKE — FREEZING VEX MID-ATTACK!
WAIT... WHY IS THE MIRROR SHOWING ME... BEFORE MALCODE?
YOU WERE NEVER EVIL, VEX — JUST LONELY! LET GO OF THAT VISOR!
AAAGH!! MALCODE LOCKED THE VISOR — IT'S SHOCKING ME!!
HANG ON, VEX!! I'M PULLING YOU OUT OF THERE!!
MALCODE TRIGGERS A CRUEL SELF-DESTRUCT LOCK — KAI DIVES STRAIGHT INTO THE LIGHTNING!
IN A BURST OF GOLDEN LOTUS LIGHT, MALCODE'S CORRUPTED VISOR SHATTERS FOREVER!
THE NOISE... IT'S FINALLY GONE...
TAKE MY HAND, VEX — YOU'RE NEVER ALONE AGAIN!
I'M SORRY... I HELPED MALCODE. CAN YOU FORGIVE ME?
GOOD CODERS FIX BUGS TOGETHER. WELCOME BACK!
ONE MISTAKE DOESN'T DEFINE YOU, VEX. STAND WITH US!
THANK YOU, KAI... I KNOW MALCODE'S SECRET BACKDOOR.
TRAITOR!! MY OBSIDIAN CITADEL WILL CRUSH ALL SEVENTEEN OF YOU!!

lines: # Missing break condition — needs a Hero's debug!
code_tray.output: WARNING: Citadel storm escalating! All 17 Guardians required!

balloons.text: THE ROOF IS COLLAPSING!! EVERYONE ONTO EMBER — NOW!!
KAI! VEX! HURRY — JUMP ON!!
FURIOUS AT VEX'S DEFECTION, MALCODE SHATTERS THE SPIRE FROM AFAR!
HERE! MALCODE'S CORE SITS BEHIND THE MAIN CITADEL GATE!
THEN IT'S TIME TO CALL EVERY SQUAD HOME!
LIGHT THE GOLDEN LOTUS BEACON!!
A PILLAR OF PLANT-BLOSSOM STARLIGHT PIERCES THE STORM CLOUDS ACROSS ALL PYTHONIA!
HANG ON TIGHT, VEX! EMBER'S GOING FULL SPEED!
I'M READY! LET'S END MALCODE'S REIGN!
GLITCH-WASPS ON OUR TAIL!! BRACE YOURSELVES!!
NEED A HAND, KAI?! AURORA, SOLAR & BLOSSOM — FIRE!!
MID-AIR AMBUSH! JUST IN TIME, THREE ELEMENTAL STREAMS BLAST THE SWARM APART!
AURORA, EMERALD, FLAME, AND RAINBOW — FOUR ELEMENTAL STREAMS CONVERGE AT THE CITADEL!
THE OTHER SQUADS ARE ALREADY HERE!!
ALL SEVENTEEN GUARDIANS — REUNITED!!
WITH EMBER AND VEX ON OUR SIDE, NOTHING CAN STOP US!
FROM FROST PEAKS TO RUNE LIBRARIES, SAN JIE CLASS STANDS TOGETHER AS ONE!
ONE CLASS! ONE CODE! SEVENTEEN GUARDIANS — GO!!

lines: guardians = squad1 + squad2 + squad3 + squad4  # 17 Guardians!
if len(guardians) == 17 and all(g.is_ready for g in allies):
code_tray.output: TRUE! 17/17 Guardians + Hero Kai, Ember & Vex — READY!

balloons.text: SQUAD ONE — NG SHUANG, KHANG KOK, EG SIU, AND UVINCC!
AURORA, ROPE, THUNDER & SKY-WIND READY!
SQUAD 1: THE SKY & STORM VANGUARD
SQUAD TWO — DAO YANG, YU CHEN, YU BHOR, AND YI REN!
HEARTH, BALANCE, COMPASS & BLOSSOM ON POINT!
SQUAD 2: THE FLAME & STARLIGHT KEEPERS
SQUAD THREE — CARLZEN, JUN MING, GISELE, MING HUI & HAO FUNG!
TIDE, BAMBOO, BERRY, ROOTS & ECO-RUNE LOCKED IN!
SQUAD 3: THE EMERALD & SANCTUARY SHIELD
SQUAD FOUR — KAI XIANG, JING CHENG, QIU RONG, AND SHI YE!
HERO KAI & VEX — LEADING THE FINAL CHARGE!
SQUAD 4: THE RUNE & STARLIGHT STRIKE TEAM
MY SILVER BACKDOOR KEY IS ALIGNED — BREAKING THE FIREWALL!!
HOLD THE LINE, EMBER!! PUSH WITH ALL OUR LOTUS LIGHT!!
VEX'S BACKDOOR KEY AND KAI'S LOTUS LIGHT SHATTER MALCODE'S INFINITE LOCK!
EVERY PARTNER IS EVOLVED. EVERY HEART IS READY.
OPEN THE THRONE ROOM GATES, EMBER!
BEYOND THE RADIANT ARCHWAY LIES THE FINAL CONFRONTATION...
AT LAST! STEP INTO MY CODE, LITTLE GUARDIANS — LET THE FINAL BATTLE BEGIN!!
THE OBSIDIAN THRONE ROOM AWAKENS WITH CRACKLING CORRUPTION!
TREMBLE BEFORE MY SIX-WING OVERRIDE!! NO ONE LEAVES ALIVE!!
STAND YOUR GROUND, ALL SEVENTEEN!! THIS ENDS TOGETHER!!
SIX CRACKLING WINGS ERUPT IN CODE-GRAVITY LIGHT — THE FINAL SHOWDOWN BEGINS!
SEVENTEEN GUARDIANS? ONE TRAITOR? MY INFINITE LOOP WILL ERASE YOU ALL!!
NOT THIS TIME, MALCODE! WE'RE FINISHING THIS TOGETHER!
YOUR BACKDOOR IS WIDE OPEN. LET'S DEBUG HIM, KAI!
